title: El cumpleaños
goal: Be invited to a birthday and turn up with the right thing
culture: The invitation is real, not a formality, and not turning up is noticed. Ask what to bring and you will be told nothing, so bring a bottle of something fizzy for the table, which is what everybody else does while saying they brought nothing.

beats.es: Vecino, buenas. Fíjese que la niña cumple años el sábado.
beats.objective: Ask whose birthday and say congratulations
beats.good: Cumplir años is to complete years, which is a better way of putting it. Felicidades goes to the family as much as to the child.

beats.es: Gracias, vecino. Ahí lo esperamos, pues.
beats.good: Ask, and take the answer as the earliest possible moment rather than the time. Nobody arrives at three.

beats.es: Como a las tres. Pero llegue cuando pueda.
beats.good: You will be told no. Ask anyway — asking is the courtesy, and then bring a big bottle of gaseosa for the table like everybody else.

beats.objective: Accept, and confirm you will be there
beats.good: Vecino and vecina are what neighbours call each other instead of names, sometimes for years. Ahí llego means you are going, so go.
